deploy:
Play a hero card with Deploy
to gain its benefit immediately.

Different Deploy heroes
grant different bonuses.

For example, Zhou Yu raises
your whole team's levels.

Lady Sun grants
free shop refreshes.

Selling the hero does not
remove the Deploy benefit.

Keep playing and selling Deploy heroes
to gain their benefits repeatedly.
engage:
Heroes with Initiate,
such as Yaria, trigger automatically

as soon as both players are ready
and combat begins.

Their effects grant
bonuses to your lineup.

Lu Bu grants lifesteal
to Three Kingdoms heroes.

Consort Yu permanently raises allies'
levels based on the number of Totems.
prepare:
Heroes with Prepare trigger their effects
in each round's preparation phase,

granting the corresponding
benefits to your lineup.

A Prepare hero you just played,
such as Cao Cao,

It must wait until
the next preparation phase.

Certain effect cards or hero cards
can trigger Prepare immediately,
without waiting for the next round.
sacrifice:
Heroes with Sacrifice trigger
when they die in combat,

granting their effect's
benefits to your lineup.

For example, Su Lie permanently
gains levels when he dies.

Dunshan gives you an Ancient Coin
when he dies.
combine:
Play a copy of a hero already deployed
to trigger Combine.

Each Combine raises that hero's
level by 3.

you receive a Trick card
at your current Chessplayer level.

The small card icon on the right
shows your Combine progress.
flash:
Heroes with Flash teleport
when combat begins

to the mirrored position
on the enemy's battlefield.
These heroes usually deal high damage.

They bypass frontline tanks
to target the enemy's backline carries.

Special equipment from talents
can also grant Flash
seize: When a hero with Steal is played,

it takes up to 10 levels from one
random allied hero within 1 tile.

If that ally has fewer than 10 levels,
it takes only the levels above 1.

The affected hero always
keeps at least 1 level.

Pay close attention to placement
when deploying a Steal hero.

Avoid taking levels from your main carry
and weakening your core damage.
temporary-levels:
Temporary Levels are
non-permanent level bonuses.
They disappear after the battle ends.

Some hero effects, talents
and effect cards

Want to keep those levels?
Try Ming.

His card effect converts some
Temporary Levels into permanent ones.

Make good use of this temporary power.
It can be the key to winning.
fleeting:
Hero cards and effect cards
with Fleeting

can only be used during
this round's preparation phase.
They disappear as soon as combat begins.

Examples include Tactics cards,
Ancient Coins and Qiao Xi's skill,

plus hero cards obtained through
Bai Ge's exclusive talent.

Use your Fleeting cards
before they disappear!
revive:
Heroes with Revive return to life
after their first death,

Heroes without innate Revive
can gain it too,

Sage's Sanctuary equipment
or certain talents.

can stack extra uses through these effects
to revive multiple times.
triumph:
Heroes with Triumph grant their benefits
after you win a battle.

For example, Niu Mo's Triumph
grants 1 Energy when you win.

Early on, if you expect
your lineup to win,
deploy Niu Mo to earn extra Energy.
defeat:
Heroes with Defeat trigger
their card effects after you lose.

For example, Mengqi's Defeat upgrades
the Hero Exchange Ticket
that you receive when you sell him.
If you want a higher-tier hero,

losing a few early rounds
can upgrade that ticket,

giving you a chance to get
your desired hero sooner.
exit: Sell a deployed hero with Withdraw
For example, selling a deployed Mengqi
gives you a Hero Exchange Ticket.

Yuhuan gives you an effect card
that advances a hero's awakening.
